answers.solution:
**Root cause (ED-GAP-023):** `MainMenu` exposes six intent signals (`*_requested`) emitted by button handlers, but `_connect_scene_signals()` only connected 3 of them. `settings_requested`/`credits_requested` had no connections (dead buttons — click does nothing), and `quit_requested` bypassed the observable choke point by calling `get_tree().quit()` inline. A secondary, pre-existing defect: `SettingsMenu._create_volume_slider()` was annotated `-> HSlider` but returned an `HBoxContainer`, raising a "Return type mismatch" SCRIPT ERROR on every call (4–6 per menu open).

### 1. `SceneOrchestrator.gd` (autoload) — register new screen constants + deferred swap + observable quit
